text:
Rana: Heads-up, ~30 nodes in eu-west got stuck in PXE during the rolling BMC firmware update. Seeing TFTP timeouts in the PXE logs.
ops-bot: [alert] provisioning.failures >= 10 in eu-west-rack-12 (count=32) — triggered at 2026-03-18T10:22:12Z
Mike: Is this the fw we pushed last night? Which image?
Rana: yes, bmc-fw v3.2.1. It added "ip-over-usb" and updated the usb-net driver. After the update nodes enumerate a usb0 with MTU 1500. Our PXE image expects jumbo frames (MTU 9000), so the UEFI TFTP transfer stalls.
Sasha: Wait pxeboot needs 9000? I thought we do fallback. Any packet drops?
Rana: Packet captures show fragmentation / ICMP frag-needed. UEFI stuck at ~8% of download, retransmit loop. When we force MTU 1500 on the switch port provisioning works but that breaks other racks that rely on jumbo frames for bulk staging.
Irene: Could secure boot toggles be related? Did the BIOS upgrade flip a bit anywhere?
Rana: BIOS didn't change in this batch. But the BMC defaulted to enabling the USB-Ethernet gadget on boot. Also noticed a handful of boards reported secureboot state="audit" from the BMC inventory — probably orthogonal but observed in same timeframe.
Mike: Quick mitigation options: rollback BMC to v3.2.0, or push an OOB script that sets `ip link set dev usb0 mtu 9000` during pre-provision. Which is faster?
Rana: We tried a one-off OOB `ip link` in the serial/OOB shell and it unblocks a node, but doing that across 30 nodes is slow. Rolling back the firmware for the rack is fastest to restore provisioning throughput.
Sasha: Plan: remove ip-over-usb gadget from the staged FW config, repush v3.2.1 without the gadget, and add a CI gate that verifies network interfaces + MTU under a QEMU BMC image. Also add a post-rollout smoke that runs a tiny PXE download.
Rana: I'll create the rollback run and a runbook entry for on-call. Marking eu-west-rack-12 as degraded and diverting new capacity to eu-west-2 for the next 24h.
Mike: Sounds good. Thanks for moving fast. :thumbsup:
ops-bot: incident created INC-2026-1047 provisioning-pxe-mtu-break
